newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: APC approves capital hike to 20 bln pesos.
newsitem.headline: APC approves capital hike to 20 bln pesos.

text.p: APC Group Inc of the Philippines said on Monday its board had approved a plan to increase its authorised capital stock to 20 billion pesos from the present 1.8 billion pesos.
Corporate secretary Bayani Tan told the Securities and Exchange Commission the board had also agreed to change its primary purpose to that of a holding company instead of an oil exploration firm.
Tan said the company had already raised 3.8 billion pesos through a private placement. He did not say how the company would raise the remainder of the new capital.
The company had also agreed to increase its par value to one peso per share from the present one centavo per share.
A special shareholders' meeting has been called on October 16 to vote on the board resolutions.
